title: Agentic AI & Automation Engineer
description: We’re building a practical Agentic AI and Automation capability at Guardrisk, and we’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to help shape it.This is not a role focused on producing AI demos or implementing technology in isolation. You will work directly with business teams to understand how work gets done, identify where processes can be simplified or automated, and turn those opportunities into working solutions.You’ll combine business process thinking, workflow automation, software engineering and applied AI to build everything from straightforward process automations and integrations to AI agents and agentic workflows.Just as importantly, you’ll help us create the capability itself: reusable components, patterns, engineering practices and skills that allow successful solutions to be applied across Guardrisk.Guardrisk’s Data & AI CoE is being designed around reusable capabilities and business-facing delivery, with AI and automation capacity forming part of that model. COE Org Structure The wider approach also envisages agents working across enterprise systems while retaining human decision-making where appropriate. CoE Ways of Working StandardWhat you will doWork directly with business users and Product Managers to understand, map and document end-to-end business processes.Identify manual work, bottlenecks, repetitive activities and hand-offs that can be simplified, automated or augmented using AI.Translate business problems into practical automation, workflow and agentic AI solutions.Rapidly prototype with users, test ideas in the real business context and turn successful prototypes into robust solutions.Design and build AI agents and agentic workflows that can reason over information, use tools, interact with enterprise systems and support business processes.Build traditional workflow automations where deterministic automation is a better fit than AI.Integrate solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, data and services.Design appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, approvals, exception handling and escalation paths.Develop reusable agent skills, tools, connectors, workflow components and automation patterns rather than solving every problem from scratch.Work with Technology, Architecture, Security and other teams to take solutions from prototype through to controlled production use.Build evaluation and monitoring into AI and automation solutions so that we understand whether they are working as intended and delivering value.Document solutions, patterns and lessons learned so that the capability becomes repeatable across Guardrisk.Help business and technical teams understand where agentic AI, conventional automation, integration or process redesign is the appropriate solution.Contribute to the standards and engineering practices that underpin Guardrisk’s emerging Agentic AI & Automation capability.Role PurposeWork directly with business users and Product Managers to understand and document business processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and design, prototype and engineer production-ready workflows, automations and AI agents on Guardrisk’s governed platforms.What makes this differentCombines workflow automation, software engineering and applied/agentic AIWorks directly in the business context to map processes, pain points, decisions, hand-offs and controlsIdentifies where to simplify, automate or augment work, rather than merely digitising an inefficient processRapidly prototypes automations and agents with users and learns through deploymentDesigns agentic workflows, orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls and exception handlingConnects business processes to systems, APIs, data, models and enterprise servicesBuilds reusable automation components, agent skills, tools and workflow patternsMakes sound design choices beyond one immediate use case, with reuse across Guardrisk in mindPartners with Technology on platform, integration, security and productionisationEstablishes the engineering practices, documentation and patterns needed to grow Guardrisk’s AI & Automation capabilitySupports adoption and measures whether deployed automations actually improve the underlying processExpected seniority: Energetic hands-on engineer with enough technical depth to engineer integrations, workflows and agents, but also enough business and product judgement to determine what should be automated, where AI adds value, where deterministic workflow is better, and where human judgement or control must remain Systems or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.Strong software engineering experience in at least one modern programming language, ideally Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript or similar.Practical experience building workflow automations, system integrations or business process solutions.Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating multiple systems or services.Hands-on experience building applications using large language models or generative AI APIs.Understanding of agentic concepts such as tool use, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, state and human-in-the-loop patterns.Experience taking solutions beyond prototypes into production or operational use.Ability to work directly with non-technical users to understand a business process and translate it into a technical solution.Strong engineering fundamentals, including source control, testing, documentation, security and maintainability.Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.Preferred qualificationsYou don’t need to have experience with every technology below. agentic workflow solutions.Experience with agent frameworks, orchestration approaches or modern AI engineering toolchains.Experience with enterprise automation technologies such as Microsoft Power Automate, Power Platform, Azure Logic Apps or equivalent workflow/orchestration platforms.Experience with the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 ecosystem, particularly where AI, automation and enterprise data intersect.Experience applying techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, structured extraction and AI-assisted workflow orchestration.Experience with process discovery, process mapping, BPMN, Lean process improvement or similar approaches.Experience designing reusable automation platforms, components, libraries or engineering patterns rather than only delivering one-off solutions.Experience implementing evaluation, observability or monitoring for AI applications.Understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security and appropriate controls description: 🚀 Ready to Lead AI Sprints, Build Smart Tools, and Put Automation Into Action from Day One? 🚀About ZURUZURU is on a mission to disrupt industries, challenge the status quo, and catalyze change through radical innovation and advances in automation. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; and ZURU Edge is pioneering new-generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers. One of the largest toy companies in the world, our globally recognized and award-winning brands include Bunch O Balloons, Mini Brands, XSHOT, Rainbocorns, and Smashers.
